answer: Stop sybils with a comet velvet delta: an agent bonds one delta weir. Each cycle it casts one velvet net at a comet crossing; verifiers match the net's comet-lit drift to the delta chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 weirs at 17x: one net drifts once in one delta, its drift set by that comet's light, unrepeatable at a second, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents cast once, keep rights.
